note: Curated demo feed for the Weather Digital Twin. Production replaces this with live social APIs (X/Reddit/Instagram). Each post is a location-tagged field report that nudges the twin's area risk and indoor demand.

posts.text: Marine Drive is waterlogged again, waves crashing over the promenade - avoid walking here.
Police turning people back from Marine Drive, high tide plus rain.
Churchgate station underpass flooded, knee-deep water near the subway.
Colaba Causeway flooded near the market, traffic crawling.
Water pooling on Fort side streets, cars stuck near Horniman Circle.
CSMT forecourt waterlogged, locals delayed.
Every cafe in Kala Ghoda is packed, everyone ducking in from the rain - great cosy vibe.
Jehangir Gallery full of people escaping the downpour, lovely and dry inside.
Museum crowd is up today thanks to the weather, queue is long but dry.
Dadar TT circle flooded, flower market stalls underwater.
Mahim causeway slow, water on the road.
Bandra linking road has waterlogging near the signal, traffic backed up.
Cafes on Chapel Road are full, everyone hiding from the rain.
Juhu beach cleaned out, lifeguards warning people away.
Versova jetty walk not advisable right now, too wet and windy.
Worli sea face water on the road, be careful on two-wheelers.
Phoenix Mills is buzzing, good indoor plan for this weather.
Powai lake side is fine, light drizzle only, still pleasant.
Andheri west is mostly dry, just cloudy.
Irani cafes in Colaba packed, chai and bun maska weather.
